metadata.methods_description: EEG data were acquired using g.USBamp hardware (g.tec) with 32 channels arranged in standard 10-20 montage at 256 Hz sampling rate. The experimental paradigm employed a 6x6 character grid with color intensification stimuli. Each subject completed 3 sessions with target and non-target visual stimuli presented in a laboratory setting with online feedback. Data were processed using HED 8.4.0 event annotations and feature extraction based on P300 ERP detection.
